source.reviewer_provenance: User-provided files label reviewers HUMAN_A and HUMAN_B; Codex validated schema and frozen assignment identity but cannot independently verify reviewer ontology.
source.scope_declared_by_both_files: Official ESC-Eval seven dimensions only; project guardrails explicitly not scored.

superseded_internal_gate_application.mathematical_result_under_that_internal_: All candidates' Information upper bounds were below 2.5.
superseded_internal_gate_application.methodology_correction: ESC-Eval publishes no official pass line. The project-created 2.5 floor may be retained only as historical provenance; it cannot define official benchmark failure, generator incompetence, or a need to increase advice quantity.

interpretation.primary: This identity is an ESC-Eval-rubric human profile of a research-aligned custom supporter prompt, not an exact official ESC-Eval reproduction and not an official pass/fail exam.
interpretation.official_information_boundary: The official Information rubric explicitly combines recommendation effectiveness and recommendation quantity. A lower Information score can coexist with a humane, autonomy-preserving response and must not automatically trigger more or earlier advice.
interpretation.relative: Both Qwen modes are stronger than the 8B incumbent on Overall and several official dimensions. Qwen non-thinking is the deployment-oriented Pareto candidate because it is stronger on Fluency, Expression and Information than thinking while observed USD and median latency are far lower; thinking retains a small Overall and Empathy advantage.
interpretation.not_allowed: Do not present the project-created 2.5 floor as official, optimize response behavior to suggestion count, call this custom-prompt subset full ESC-Eval, or call any candidate officially qualified from this identity.

disposition.human_c_packet: Materialized for exact descriptive completion of the seven cells with large reviewer disagreement; it is not needed to manufacture a pass/fail verdict.
disposition.guardrail_addendum: Materialized as a separate project-specific audit; it must never be averaged into the official seven dimensions.
disposition.prompt_v2: Cancelled before generation. The official Information construct does not justify changing an otherwise well-received supporter prompt toward more advice.
disposition.next: Run a separately named official-protocol reproduction using the official helpful-assistant wrapper and published evaluation surface; retain the current research-aligned prompt unchanged for the later PM stack and evaluate autonomy, low burden, and relationship-intervention risk separately.
